dedupe_resolutions.notes: CENTCOM's completion announcement, the named target categories and Iranian retaliation are later lifecycle developments in the existing Hormuz conflict record, not a second war event.
The reported passport draft is the proposed implementation mechanism for Executive Order 14418 and belongs in the existing birthright-citizenship record rather than a parallel entry.
The 19-delegation G20 chair's statement materially advances the same trade-imbalance proposal recorded six hours earlier.

The records share a same-day White House fact sheet because it reports both manufacturer pricing arrangements and Medicare Bridge uptake. One is a set of announced company agreements; the other is an administration-reported program measurement. Neither duplicates the other's event or unit.

The shared EO 14420 token is intentionally preserved in the grid record's timestamped correction note and source description. The official Federal Register assigns EO 14421 to the August 26 grid order and EO 14420 to the August 10 vaccine order; the records concern distinct events and subjects.

Both records arise from the U.S.-hosted G20 meetings on September 1, but they document distinct proposals in separate tracks: light-touch AI governance at the technology meeting and trade barriers responding to Chinese export imbalances at the finance ministerial.

rejected_candidates.title: Fourteen new Truth Social posts
rejected_candidates.reason: The feed advanced from 36,020 to 36,034 posts. Disaster-aid posts were treated as research leads and only funding supported by located FEMA releases entered the canonical record. Trump's later Iran post documented his published position but did not independently verify operational claims. Endorsements, G20 promotion, opinion links, image-only material and routine rhetoric did not establish another qualifying federal action.

rejected_candidates.title: Uncorroborated state- and tribal-specific disaster-aid totals
rejected_candidates.reason: Trump announced separate amounts for Kentucky, Missouri, Kansas, North Dakota, Texas, Iowa and the Oglala Sioux Tribe. The posts establish that he announced the totals, but award instruments or independent confirmation matching each amount were not located by cutoff; they remain outside the grouped FEMA record.

rejected_candidates.title: Hung Cao nomination announcement
rejected_candidates.reason: Trump announced an intended nomination for secretary of the Navy, but no White House nomination transmission or Senate record was located by cutoff. Routine personnel announcements without a formal nomination or appointment are withheld.

rejected_candidates.title: Congressional stopgap funding bill
rejected_candidates.reason: The bill had passed Congress but was not signed by cutoff. Enactment, a veto or another operative development will be recorded rather than presenting pending legislation as an appropriation already in force.

rejected_candidates.title: Iran bank sanctions and other prospective announcements
rejected_candidates.reason: The anticipated Iranian bank designation remained unidentified and unissued. Prospective Chevron activity, additional G20 statements and other policy previews did not create another completed U.S. action or agreement by cutoff.

rejected_candidates.title: COSCO intelligence allegations and other anonymous reports
rejected_candidates.reason: Consequential operational claims continued to rest substantially on unnamed officials without adequate independent confirmation or a new public primary record. They remain research leads rather than findings.

rejected_candidates.title: Routine personnel, endorsements, criminal and duplicate coverage
rejected_candidates.reason: Campaign endorsements, routine personnel chatter, promotional posts, opinion links, private or state litigation and duplicate coverage did not establish another material national Trump-administration action in the window.
